title: Make online recruitment user friendly: Madras HC orders TNPC to introduce correction window in portal
description: The Madras High Court recently directed Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission (TNPSC) to include a correction window for all recruitments to allow candidates rectify mistakes in their job applications [The Secretary, TNPSV Vs M Senthilkumar and another]A Division Bench of Justices GR Swaminathan and Justice S Srimathy called upon the State recruiting agency to audit its online recruitment process and make it user-friendly.
